programs.title: Australia's Big Backyards
programs.desc: Join Australia’s much-loved gardening gurus Jason Hodges and Graham Ross for a ringside seat to some of Australia’s most extraordinary gardens and magical festivals.

programs.title: Weekender
programs.desc: Whether it is day tripping to the reef, watching a fiery outback sunset, or brunch at a cool city cafe, Weekender will inspire you to make the most of your precious break.

programs.title: Auction Squad
programs.desc: Host Johanna Griggs, with the help of the team - Patrick Thompson, Candy Day, Will Dangar, Luke Dyer and Jason Hodges - give a faded Queenslander a king-size makeover. The team start work building a new laundry complete with a tuck-away washing machine and sink. A half-renovated bathroom is completed with gleaming new fittings and new white tiles. A lush tropical garden is created, and with new pavers, the tired old path has made way for a spectacular, inviting entranceway.

programs.title: Harry's Practice
programs.desc: Join Dr Harry Cooper and Dr Katrina Warren for everything you need to know about animals.

programs.title: RSPCA Animal Rescue
programs.desc: A stray mother cat is taken in to the RSPCA but she has given birth to some kittens that are caught in a tight space.

programs.title: Better Homes And Gardens
programs.desc: With the budget increasing each week for three weeks, Charlie's going to makeover a front garden in three ways to show you the things you can do with a small, medium and big budget.
